sourcePrompt: SWISH Modular Production Readiness Master Directive

stages.name: Full architectural audit
stages.goal: Establish an evidence-based map of current architecture, shared services, niche modules, security boundaries and release blockers.

tasks.title: Map app entry points, routes and build identities
tasks.evidence: docs/SWISH_STAGE_ONE_ARCHITECTURE_AUDIT.md#s1-01; PR #85 merge 00aa203 with 25/25 route-registry checks; PR #90 niche-routing workflow run 810 completed successfully on tested head; main snapshot 8d84f319cb778c84cf1ba1152c8a2b56c2680dd0. Verified registry, entry/home/dedicated route ownership and configured build identity source contract. Installed-device launch remains outside this verification.

tasks.title: Map shared services, hooks, backend functions and database dependencies
tasks.evidence: Updated after PR #126 merged to main as e3df8fe19b1d3444919ddac77dadd41a5429acf1. docs/SWISH_STAGE_ONE_ARCHITECTURE_AUDIT.md maps app/services/hooks, OnSpace Cloud canonical backend, 47 unique files with direct database query matches (43 supabase.from plus five getSupabaseClient().from matches, one overlap), 29 Edge Function invocation files, 25 deployable Edge Function entry points and 12 tracked SQL migrations. docs/SWISH_EDGE_FUNCTION_SECURITY_MATRIX.md inventories source-observed auth/tenant/entitlement/privileged gates. PR #126 CI passed: master-admin-readiness run 41460220912 (14/14 jobs), branded-web-builds run 41460220448 (10/10 exports), niche-config-checks run 41460220384. These are repository/source checks only. Deployed OnSpace Cloud function revision parity, effective RLS/grants, internal-secret callers, direct-query authorization mapping and live runtime tests remain outstanding; keep IMPLEMENTED, not VERIFIED. Refreshed source review at main `b1f805e22139ba89c3267dbf9c7b21f50582a9f9` also found a high-priority `swish-ebay-list` global `x-swish-internal-secret` bypass: the secret branch creates no user identity/tenant membership and skips conditional paid-niche authorization. No in-repository caller was found; external/OnSpace callers remain unknown. `swish-ebay-sync` is JWT-only in source despite a dead secret variable/comment. This is a blocker for verification and requires safe caller/deployment confirmation before any removal.

tasks.title: Audit every registered niche for real functionality and isolation
tasks.evidence: Static audit covers all ten canonical niche identities and now all ten descriptor files, including tech and surplus_flip added in PR #126 (merged as e3df8fe19b1d3444919ddac77dadd41a5429acf1). services/__tests__/registeredNicheAudit.test.ts checks descriptor parity against canonical registry fields. PR #126 CI passed niche-config-checks (run 41460220384), regression/niche isolation and all ten branded Android bundle jobs (run 41460220912), and all ten web exports (run 41460220448). This verifies source/config/build contracts, not real scanner-to-listing workflows or live tenant/RLS isolation. Shared-capture niches and bespoke-home gaps remain; keep IMPLEMENTED, not VERIFIED.

tasks.title: Record security, entitlement, eBay, finance, sync and release blockers
tasks.evidence: docs/SWISH_STAGE_ONE_ARCHITECTURE_AUDIT.md#s1-04, docs/SWISH_ENGINEERING_AUDIT.md, docs/SWISH_ENGINEERING_HANDOVER.md and docs/SWISH_EDGE_FUNCTION_SECURITY_MATRIX.md consolidate security, entitlement, eBay finance/messages/sync, category specifics, order allocation, Android API 36, device, deployment and live-backend blockers. PR #126 refreshed the source security inventory for all 25 deployable Edge Function entry points. This verifies the blocker register as an audit artifact only; remediation and live acceptance remain open in downstream stages.

tasks.title: Reconcile open PRs, branches and current main before implementation
tasks.evidence: Reconciled after PR #126 merge on 2026-11-02. GitHub API confirms main at e3df8fe19b1d3444919ddac77dadd41a5429acf1 and zero open pull requests at the time of check. PR #126 merged only after all required workflows passed: run 41460220912 (14/14 jobs), run 41460220448 (10/10 web exports), run 41460220384 (niche-routing). Repeat the open-PR/main check before every subsequent merge or release.

stages.name: Foundation 1 — SWISH Core
stages.goal: Complete shared authentication, tenancy, storage, AI, capture, inventory, eBay, lifecycle, pricing, notifications and navigation foundations.

tasks.title: Verify shared auth, tenant and server-side entitlement enforcement
tasks.evidence: Shared paid-niche authorization is enforced in the core identification, Islamic identification, market valuation, listing generation, listing verification/human override, repricing and authenticated eBay publication paths. The privileged service-role paths derive niche ownership from the stored item's specialist and use the common requirePaidNiche guard; reprice also confirms the requested niche matches canonical specialist ownership. Added regression coverage for the guards and execution ordering. PR #117 merged as 5da0fdd. Remaining verification: live RLS and tenant-isolation integration against the existing OnSpace-managed backend, plus operational tests with real subscriber/lifetime accounts. Other tenant-scoped eBay account operations remain tenant-level by design.

tasks.title: Verify shared storage, image capture and AI service contracts
tasks.evidence: docs/S3_CORE_ACCEPTANCE_REPORT.md: existing storage, image capture and AI service contracts remain in place; no full authenticated media/AI end-to-end acceptance or deployed revision parity was run. Keep IN PROGRESS.

tasks.title: Verify shared inventory and lifecycle services
tasks.evidence: All identified item-status transition paths now use the existing atomic `swish_transition_item` RPC or the shared `markItemSold`/`transitionItemStatus` helpers: generic `updateItem` rejects status changes; Stock Listing manual sale, manual order creation, eBay CSV sold-history import, eBay order ingestion, eBay listing publication and eBay listing sync all use the lifecycle command. PR #122 merged as 46a412d with passing lint, TypeScript, Edge Function syntax, 1,030-test regression, shared authorization, Android JS bundle and ten-niche Expo configuration checks. Static audit of the remaining `items` updates found only non-status field updates and initial record creation. Status IMPLEMENTED, not VERIFIED: quantity/partial-sale semantics, live RLS and end-to-end backend lifecycle/reconciliation tests remain open.

tasks.title: Verify secure eBay OAuth, listing, orders, messages and sync flows
tasks.evidence: Source implementation includes bounded sequential GetMyMessages pagination (10 pages × 50), namespace-tolerant XML parsing, explicit partial-sync reporting and inbox handling. PR #130 merged as 0f24568; PR #132 CI run 41465023973 passed the five pagination tests within the 554-test/13-suite regression suite. Still IN PROGRESS: actual eBay response/seller permission acceptance, message bodies, remote send, deployed OnSpace Cloud revision and mailbox-over-cap retrieval.

tasks.title: Verify pricing, fees, profit, notifications and settings foundations
tasks.evidence: Source implementation includes fee aggregation sign handling and finance partial/incomplete reporting (`docs/S3_CORE_ACCEPTANCE_REPORT.md`), plus profit engine v1.3 with current UK business/private seller estimates, category tiers, regulatory fee, order fixed fee and separate buyer/seller postage. Ten focused fee tests passed in PR #132 CI run 41465023973 (554 tests/13 suites total); four Deno authorization tests, lint, TypeScript, register validation and Edge Function syntax/secret-boundary checks passed. Still IN PROGRESS: exact seller/account fee acceptance, multi-line/quantity allocation, historical finance 400/499 diagnosis and live order/finance reconciliation; no notification delivery service has been added.

stages.name: Foundation 2 — Standard resale workflow
stages.goal: Deliver one complete, repeatable scan-to-sale workflow for every supported niche.

tasks.title: Scan, identify, confidence and evidence
tasks.evidence: IMPLEMENTED source baseline: `docs/SPECIALIST_IMPLEMENTATION_REPORT.md` sections B/D/G documents shared capture/review, canonical specialist routing, confidence/evidence handling and per-niche output schemas. Ten specialist profiles and capture contracts are covered by the specialist tests; PR #128 regression/isolation workflow run 41461306201 passed. Not VERIFIED: no real-image/device acceptance or measured confidence calibration for all ten niches.

tasks.title: Condition, valuation and acquisition decision
tasks.evidence: IMPLEMENTED source baseline: specialist profiles define niche condition/value rules; the buying-decision panel separates sold evidence from asking/manual scenarios and models repair, postage, labour, break-even and yield sensitivity. Market-value source labels are explicit. Not VERIFIED: actual approved sold-data access, per-niche valuation accuracy and safety/condition acceptance remain open.

tasks.title: Costs, margin, inventory and listing draft
tasks.evidence: IMPLEMENTED source baseline: buying panel costs/margin scenarios, canonical inventory persistence, atomic listing-draft RPC and specifics-preserving saveListing path are documented in `docs/SPECIALIST_IMPLEMENTATION_REPORT.md` sections B/E/G. Not VERIFIED: authenticated concurrent draft calls and complete capture-to-inventory-to-draft acceptance remain open.

tasks.title: eBay category, item specifics, edit, save and publish
tasks.evidence: IMPLEMENTED source baseline: niche-aware listing generation, existing Taxonomy/category/aspect retrieval, item-specific preservation, editor save RPC and existing publish infrastructure are documented in `docs/SPECIALIST_IMPLEMENTATION_REPORT.md` sections B/G. Not VERIFIED: category/aspect completeness for every niche and controlled live eBay draft/publish/revise/end acceptance remain open; direct privileged publish authorization review remains a blocker.

tasks.title: Sales, fees, order reconciliation and profit
tasks.evidence: IMPLEMENTED source baseline: existing order ingestion/reconciliation, fee aggregation sign handling, estimate-vs-actual profit presentation and finance partial/incomplete reporting are documented in `docs/S3_CORE_ACCEPTANCE_REPORT.md`. Not VERIFIED: multi-line/quantity fee allocation, historical finance 400/499 diagnosis and live order/finance reconciliation remain release risks.

stages.name: Foundation 3 — Niche specialisation
stages.goal: Make each niche a distinct specialist configuration over shared foundations, with strict data and entitlement isolation.

tasks.title: Validate specialist IDs, prompts and capture requirements per niche
tasks.evidence: IMPLEMENTED source baseline: canonical specialist ownership, ten versioned prompt/output profiles and per-specialist capture requirements are documented in `docs/SPECIALIST_IMPLEMENTATION_REPORT.md`; PR #121 and its 25/25 checks cover required capture slots/server-supported capture modes; PR #128 regression/isolation run 41461306201 passed. Not VERIFIED: prompt-specific output acceptance on real images/devices remains open.

tasks.title: Validate niche attributes, condition and measurements
tasks.evidence: IMPLEMENTED source baseline: ten specialist profiles define niche attributes, condition/value/listing rules; saved stock detail supports niche-aware editable fields, bounded corrections and tenant/niche-scoped optimistic writes (`docs/SPECIALIST_IMPLEMENTATION_REPORT.md`, sections A/B). Not VERIFIED: all niche fields have not been exercised through live save/reopen/device scenarios.

tasks.title: Validate valuation sources, category mappings and listing templates
tasks.evidence: IMPLEMENTED source baseline: niche-specific valuation/source guidance and listing templates/item-specific mapping are documented in `docs/SPECIALIST_IMPLEMENTATION_REPORT.md`, sections A/F/G. Not VERIFIED: authorised sold-data provider access, live leaf-category/aspect validation and all-niche live listing acceptance remain open.

tasks.title: Verify niche inventory, routes, permissions and branding isolation
tasks.evidence: IMPLEMENTED source baseline: canonical `niche-modules.json`, ten module descriptors, niche-aware routes/specialist ownership and inventory isolation regression coverage are in place; PR #126 and PR #128 ten-niche build/regression checks passed. Not VERIFIED: live cross-tenant/wrong-niche access tests and hosted web/device isolation remain open.

stages.name: Foundations 4–6 — Optional specialist capabilities
stages.goal: Add advanced intelligence, specialist business tools and unique niche engines only where justified by the niche.

tasks.title: Select advanced intelligence capabilities by niche
tasks.evidence: IMPLEMENTED scoped selection: `docs/SPECIALIST_IMPLEMENTATION_REPORT.md` section A records niche-by-niche justified advanced intelligence and explicit deferrals; section B documents the shared evidence/confidence, specialist analysis and market-research capabilities. Research-only integrations are not represented as shipped.

tasks.title: Select specialist business tools by niche
tasks.evidence: IMPLEMENTED scoped selection: section A of `docs/SPECIALIST_IMPLEMENTATION_REPORT.md` maps niche business needs to implemented starting tools (buying decision, card grading scenarios, surplus manifest/buying analysis, specialist capture/review). Unintegrated manufacturer/checklist/recall services remain explicitly deferred.

tasks.title: Implement unique niche engines only where required
tasks.evidence: IMPLEMENTED selectively, not as a blanket feature set: existing coin/Numista and Islamic tools, surplus manifest/decomposition, card grading scenarios and specialist buying/capture slices are retained or enhanced where justified. The implementation report explicitly lists advanced catalogue, fitment, recall, collection-tracking and other integrations as not integrated; those remain deferred until evidence/licensing/API approval.

tasks.title: Test optional modules cannot contaminate unrelated niches
tasks.evidence: IMPLEMENTED source regression baseline: canonical registry/descriptor contracts, specialist routing and niche-isolation tests are present; PR #128 regression/isolation job and ten branded Android JS bundle jobs all passed in workflow run 41461306201. Not VERIFIED against live multi-tenant accounts or real devices.

stages.name: Full production verification
stages.goal: Certify supported niches through automated, security, web, native, deployment and real-device evidence.

tasks.title: Run full type, lint, unit, integration and regression suites
tasks.evidence: PR #132 CI run 41465023973: lint, production register validation, shared app/Master Admin TypeScript, 554 tests across 13 suites, four Deno paid-niche authorization tests, Edge Function syntax/secret-boundary guard, all ten branded Android JavaScript bundles and private Master Admin bundle passed. Web exports 10/10 passed in run 41465024074; niche routing/config passed in 41465023802. Live integration gate was disabled and is not counted as live acceptance.

tasks.title: Verify tenant, niche, entitlement and credential security
tasks.evidence: PR #132 CI run 41465023973 passed the Edge Function syntax/secret-boundary guard, four Deno paid-niche authorization tests and 554-test regression/niche isolation suite; ten niche Android JS bundles and Master Admin bundle passed. This is source/CI evidence only; deployed OnSpace Cloud RLS/grants and live tenant/role/entitlement verification remain outstanding.

tasks.title: Verify web parity and production deployment
tasks.evidence: PR #132 branded web run 41465024074 passed production exports for all ten niche variants; niche routing/config run 41465023802 passed. Actual hosted deployment, domain routing, authenticated web parity and production smoke tests remain outstanding.

tasks.title: Build and inspect release APKs only at release milestones
tasks.evidence: PR #132 run 41465023973 passed Android JavaScript bundles and branded configurations for all ten niches plus the private Master Admin launcher. No native APK/AAB was produced by these checks. Native release artifacts, persistent signing and owner APK/AAB inspection remain outstanding; continue to reserve builds for release milestones.

tasks.title: Complete real-device, live integration and operational acceptance
Close all critical/high defects and publish evidence-backed release verdict
Meet Google Play release requirements for each published niche app
tasks.evidence: Google Play policy requires Android 16 (API 36) for new apps and app updates from 31 August 2026. PR #112 adds a shared Expo config plugin, generated Gradle property verification, SDK 36/Build Tools 36.0.0 installation and APK target-SDK assertions. It also adds EAS APK profiles for all ten niches, matching `*-play` Android App Bundle profiles, and a separate owner-only Master Admin APK profile. This remains BLOCKED until API 36 native builds and target manifests pass, persistent release signing is confirmed, signed AABs are generated for all published niche package IDs, and per-app Play Console declarations/policy review are completed. The owner-only Master Admin launcher remains a separate internal-distribution artifact. PR #112 also increments niche and Master Admin runtime versions for the native API 36 rebuild and restricts automatic OTA publication to JS/assets-only paths; native app config, plugins, dependencies and Gradle changes no longer trigger OTA publication without a rebuilt APK.

knownReleaseRisks: Paid niche access and trusted server-side entitlement enforcement require complete API/RLS coverage.
eBay finance recurring 400/499 and fee aggregation/sign conventions remain unresolved.
eBay messaging must not report success after a failed provider send.
eBay localized category aspect/item-specific normalization requires live verification.
Some inventory/detail paths need trusted niche authorization rather than tenant-only checks.
Marketplace reconciliation for listings missing external IDs needs verification.
Multi-line and multi-quantity order allocation, fee aggregation and interrupted-import recovery remain incomplete.
Real APK/device launches, signing, web parity, deployment and external CI billing constraints require evidence.

Merged PR #88 (719b7c3): Production Control now displays live ten-niche web export, artifact, regression, authorization and Android JS bundle evidence with explicit limits. Merged PR #89 (89ed4c3): added a selectable ten-niche certification matrix; all 140 niche-specific acceptance areas remain NOT VERIFIED until evidence is recorded. Stage S1 audit pass: S1-01 VERIFIED against PR #85 route-registry checks and PR #90 niche-routing CI; S1-02 architecture map IMPLEMENTED in docs/SWISH_STAGE_ONE_ARCHITECTURE_AUDIT.md; S1-03 remains IN PROGRESS after static review of all ten niches, with shared scanner fallback and generic-home gaps recorded; S1-04 blocker map IMPLEMENTED; S1-05 VERIFIED against current main 8d84f31 and GitHub open-PR query (none open). Merged PR #97 (069308bf): refreshed production register and Stage S1 evidence. Merged PR #99 (dd0ff10) with 15/15 checks: hardened swish-list-generate against absent/null/malformed AI item_specifics before specialist enrichment.
